history.summary: A 2016 99-yr leasehold 4BR (former EC) in Punggol (D19), 1,227 sqft at $2.0M / $1,630 psf, 510m from Kadaloor LRT. Right at the $2M psychological/liquidity ceiling for a 4BR, LRT-only access and no project URA data make it a fair-value family hold rather than an investment standout.
history.rating_rationale: $1,630 psf for a 10-year-old 99-yr LH 4BR in Punggol is at the upper edge of fair. $2.0M is a hard ceiling for a 4BR buyer pool. Kadaloor LRT (510m) is convenient but still LRT-only. No project URA series; score_1000 547, even 236-176 arena record. Regional D19 PDD/CRL tailwind is the main upside.
red_flags: $2.0M tops the comfortable price band for a 4BR niche unit
LRT-only connectivity (Kadaloor LRT) — feeder ride to Punggol MRT
No project-specific URA appreciation data — regional-baseline fallback
Former-EC stock — large supply of comparable units caps scarcity
catalysts: Punggol Digital District + Cross Island Line regional growth
510m to Kadaloor LRT — walkable transit within Punggol
Spacious 1,227 sqft family layout for HDB upgraders
